findings.claim: Section 232 steel and aluminum tariffs rose to 50%, putting upward pressure on purchased components and raw material costs, mostly in Repair and Specialty Valve lines
findings.excerpt: While tariffs are adversely impacting several product lines, Repair and Specialty Valve product lines are bearing most of the higher costs. In 2025, the U.S. government announced significant changes to its trade policy, including tariff increases on imported steel and aluminum from 25% to 50% under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act (“Section 232”).

findings.claim: In January 2025 the company ceased melting and casting at its legacy brass foundry and moved production to a new foundry
findings.excerpt: In January 2025, we ceased melting and casting operations at our legacy brass foundry and transitioned production to our new state-of-the-art foundry.

findings.claim: Ariel, Israel facility had production delays in 2023 after the war; the company added suppliers to mitigate
findings.excerpt: Our facility in Jingmen, China, manufactures and assembles specialty valve products, and our facility in Ariel, Israel, designs, manufactures, and assembles repair products and solutions.
